_comment: Spec 012 R16. Recorded by tools/bench/run.ts --baseline; compared by --check on the same machine and the same harness settings, 20% down on req/s and 25% up on RSS. Measures apps/sample. Not comparable to the section 14 figures in docs/01-architecture, nor to this file's own pre-2026-08-31 figures, which measured apps/web before it left the repository. Re-recorded on 2026-08-31 for spec 015 T10: apps/sample now runs the framework web pipeline, which costs articles 66% of its throughput to response compression, so the Phase 1 figures would have made --check red on every future run. The drop is measured and bisected in docs/02-reference/performance.md, bottleneck 4. See tools/bench/README.md.
